Author: Sandro
Name: NahjaUI
Punchline: A complete, modular interface for Final Fantasy XIV.
Description:
NahjaUI gives the game a clean, consistent interface that you build piece by piece. Switch on only what you want: everything else stays exactly as the game made it.

HUD bars: your parameter bar, target, target of target, focus target and party list.
Progress bars: your casts and your target's, with a slidecast marker, plus a global cooldown bar that shows the queue and weave windows.
Job gauges, status effects, nameplates and enmity list, each one with its own style.
Trackers: pick the enhancements, enfeeblements and cooldowns you want to see. Every job comes with ready-made presets.
Profiles: save, copy and share your whole setup.

Type /nui to open it.

Join the testers on Discord: https://nahjaui.github.io/discord
Changelog: New: Red Mage Verfire Ready and Verstone Ready auras (a flame arc at each side of the character, with the time left shown as the color fades out). New: Red Mage gauge. The Mana Stacks show only from level 68, the combo mark follows your level, and an inner glow tells which side is unbalanced and when the enchanted combo is ready. New: leaving Unlock Mode now asks whether to save the changes or discard them, and a backup of your settings is made before you start moving things. Fixed: number fields (width, height, offsets...) no longer change the value with every digit you type; it is applied when you press Enter or leave the field. Fixed: abilities with one charge (Acceleration at low level) no longer lose their timer halfway through the cooldown, and abilities with several charges show the time of the next one. Fixed: the Freecure and Sacred Sight auras no longer flash gray before their timer is read. Changed: the time of a DoT that is not urgent yet keeps the same size as the urgent one, so it no longer jumps. Changed: the Black Mage comes with its auras in their final place, and its High Thunder tracker with the last-6-seconds window for every Thunder. Firestarter, Thunderhead and Paradox trackers come switched off because they have auras; you can still switch them on. Transpose is no longer added by default. Clean installs only: existing setups keep what they have.
